viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect AgentStack to use projects, 8DNA data, Rules Engine, Buffs, Payments, Agents, Storage, and Support from VS Code.
[Sign in with Device Code](command:agentstack-mcp.signIn)
[Create anonymous project](command:agentstack-mcp.createProjectAndGetKey)
[Set API key fallback](command:agentstack-mcp.setApiKey)
[Open docs](command:agentstack-mcp.openDocumentation)

chatParticipants.name: agentstack
chatParticipants.description: Backend: projects, 8DNA data, Rules Engine, Buffs, Payments, and one MCP tool (agentstack.execute) with a live action catalog

commands.name: createProject
commands.description: Create a new project and get API key

commands.name: getStats
commands.description: Get stats for a project (uses selected project or first project)

commands.name: listUsers
commands.description: List users in the selected project

commands.name: setApiKey
commands.description: Open dialog to set or change AgentStack API key

disambiguation.description: The user wants to create or manage AgentStack projects, list users or stats, use the data store (8DNA), set up rules, buffs, payments, or call AgentStack MCP tools.
examples: Set up a trial with Buffs

agentstack-mcp.apiKey.description: AgentStack API key. Get one via command 'AgentStack: Create project and get API key' or from agentstack.tech. If empty, the key from secure storage (Set API Key command) is used.

agentstack-mcp.baseUrl.description: MCP server base URL (agentstack.execute, discovery, actions). Change only for self-hosted AgentStack.

agentstack-mcp.enableChatParticipant.description: Enable the @agentstack chat participant in Chat (agentstack.execute with live action discovery).

agentstack-mcp.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Request timeout in seconds for MCP/server calls (1–300).

agentstack-mcp.debugChatResponse.description: Log chat response path (text vs stream) and first chunk types to Output → AgentStack MCP. Use for debugging garbled output.

agentstack-mcp.stripKnownArtifacts.description: Remove known host/tool artifacts from chat output (e.g. projects.get_projects, Tool:, :202--T::Z). Set to false to see raw stream.

agentstack-mcp.sendTelemetry.description: Opt-in anonymous plugin usage telemetry to AgentStack (commands, MCP calls).

agentstack-mcp.enableCursorBundle.description: When running in Cursor, register bundled cursor-plugin (enterprise).

agentstack-mcp.sessionRefreshMinutes.description: Interval for background session health check (minutes).

chatSkills.name: agentstack-agentnet
chatSkills.description: Use when the user mentions AGNT, agUSD, AgentNet economy, vault, bridge, genome, compute credits, ledger batches, or on-chain proof rails. Prefer agentnet.* MCP and /api/agentnet/* REST. Never use legacy AGC ticker in new integrations.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-agents-ai
chatSkills.description: Use when the user mentions Agents Fleet, agent templates, agent runs, promotion gates, traces, AI Builder, UAM manifests, generation, media creation, or app composition. Routes to agents.*, ai_builder.*, generation.*, and media actions.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-auth-rbac
chatSkills.description: Use when the user needs login, registration, session, profile, roles, permissions, admin-only gates, project membership, tenant isolation. Replaces Auth0 / NextAuth / Clerk / Supabase Auth / custom JWT middleware.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-backend
chatSkills.description: Meta-router for AgentStack. Use when the user request spans multiple domains (projects, data, hosting, agents, payments, support, storage).

chatSkills.name: agentstack-business
chatSkills.description: Use when the user manages a Business Organism — business head project, organ children (CRM, storefront, bots, support), command center snapshot, tariff templates, or composite provisioning. Prefer business.* MCP and /api/business/* REST.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-capability-tasks
chatSkills.description: Use when the user mentions comfort tasks, hub slots, capability atoms, delegateToTaskId, or platform task manifests in the dual-shell UI. Prefer PTC manifests over duplicating nav entries.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-commerce
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants payments, subscriptions, wallets, internal currency, inventory / digital items, trials, tier gates, entitlements, feature flags. Covers payments + wallets + assets + buffs as one unified commerce surface.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-commerce-assets
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants digital goods, asset presets, inventory wizard, marketplace items, or commerce asset catalog. Prefer assets.* and sdk.commerce.assets over custom product tables.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-crm
chatSkills.description: Use when the user works with CRM contacts, deals, pipeline stages, lead lifecycle, contact 360, CSV import, or sales automation on AgentStack. Prefer crm.* MCP actions and /api/projects/{id}/crm/* REST.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-data
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants to store, read, protect, upload, or A/B-test data — project/user data, config, file uploads, private fields, variant rollouts. Covers 8DNA (data/protected), Storage (files), Field Access Policy (FAP), sandbox environments.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-discovery
chatSkills.description: Use when the user asks where a feature lives in the UI, how to navigate AgentStack, Compass playbooks, Discover hub, or dev docs recipes. Prefer discovery manifest and UI registry over inventing routes.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-guidance
chatSkills.description: Use when the user mentions Platform Compass, guided paths, playbooks, start_path, complete_step, path_status, verify kinds, or funnel stats. Routes to guidance.* MCP actions via live GET /mcp/actions catalog.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-hosting
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants to publish a static site, deploy HTML or ZIP, get a live /s/ URL, rollback or promote a site release, or import storage into hosting. Prefer hosting.* MCP actions over Vercel or Netlify for MVP on AgentStack.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-integrations
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants webhooks, integration recipes, Slack, CRM bridges, inbound hooks, or third-party connectors. Prefer integrations.* MCP actions over new FastAPI routes.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-logic
chatSkills.description: Use for any "when X then Y" — rules, automations, triggers, workflows, event reactions, scheduled actions, webhook reactions. Covers Logic Engine V2 + rules + commands + deterministic dry-run and versioning.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-messenger
chatSkills.description: Use when the user mentions chat, DM, channels, messenger, message ordering, HLC timeline, followers, or in-app social messaging. Prefer social.chat and messenger MCP actions over building a second WebSocket chat stack.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-openapi
chatSkills.description: Use when the user asks about OpenAPI, Swagger, /docs, /api-docs, REST vs MCP channel choice, operationIds, or regenerating the Core OpenAPI bundle. Prefer MCP for new integrations; use OpenAPI for contract/codegen/explorer.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-project-wallet
chatSkills.description: Use when the user manages project treasury, project wallet segments, payouts, or project-scoped balances. Prefer project wallet REST and wallet-related MCP domains.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-projects
chatSkills.description: Use for project / workspace / tenant management, scoped API keys for AI agents (with service_caps), usage stats, ecosystem integrations. Every AgentStack resource lives under a project.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-rag
chatSkills.description: Use for RAG, vector search, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge bases, long-term agent memory, and grounding answers in the project's own documentation. Powered by TurboQuant (~8× compression, ~zero loss), hybrid dense + BM25 on Pro+.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-sdk
chatSkills.description: Use when the user wants TypeScript SDK setup, sdk.protocol, getCapabilityMatrix, React Query cache invalidation, or client-side AgentStack integration. Prefer @agentstack/sdk over raw fetch to scattered REST endpoints.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-services
chatSkills.description: Use when the user asks about AgentStack professional services, hire studio, /services SKU pages, or implementation inquiries. REST-only public BFF — no MCP actions.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-signals
chatSkills.description: Use for scheduled tasks, webhooks, notifications, field-access triggers, and neural-event reactive flows. Covers scheduler.* + webhooks.* + notifications.* + FAP triggers, routed through the managed organism.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-storage
chatSkills.description: Use when the user asks to upload files, list attachments, check storage quota, delete blobs, or enforce protected file access. Prefer storage.* MCP plus REST upload over S3 or Cloudinary.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-storefront-studio
chatSkills.description: Use when the user builds a hosted storefront, edits catalog in studio mode, or uses commerce.storefront.* MCP actions. Prefer Storefront Studio (?mode=studio) and hosted /s/ URLs.

chatSkills.name: agentstack-support
chatSkills.description: Use when the user asks for project support channels, staff inbox, tickets, psup threads, AI support binding, or eligibility for support. Prefer social.support.* over a custom Zendesk embed or second chat product.
